problem.statement: Preserve or improve task acceptance while loading only approved task-relevant knowledge from pinned external Expert Skill snapshots as a small session-scoped adapted context.
problem.not_the_goal: Minimizing context independently of quality, verification, provenance, and safety.
problem.current_gap: The current Router selects ACTIVE capability IDs and the current Skill Materializer copies complete Skill bundles; there is no approved atomic adapted-context layer between them and the LLM.

v8_3_evidence.interpretation_guard: V8.3-1 and V8.3-2 are separate waves. Wave 2 does not overwrite Wave 1 results or adoption decisions.
limitations: One fixed-seed Qwen run per slot does not establish repeated-run or cross-model causality.
Wave 2 changed validator semantics and explicit output contracts, so all observed PASS changes cannot be attributed only to context.
Thirteen of the eighteen Wave 1 failed slots had MODEL_CAPABILITY as the primary classified cause.
Wave 1 adoption decisions remain authoritative: only kd-sympy and kd-citation-management are ADAPT_CANDIDATE.

implementation_decisions_required: failure fallback and Human Gate conditions

preserved: Skill Materializer responsibility for complete optional Skill bundles
V8.3 snapshots, benchmark Evidence, and adoption decisions
new_components: provenance, permission, safety, and quality Verifier

boundaries.router: Remains authoritative for ACTIVE capabilities and is not modified, rescored, or overridden by the adapted selector.
boundaries.activation: Existing permission gates are an authoritative lower bound; adaptation cannot lower a gate by omitting instructions.
boundaries.skill_materializer: Continues to copy full optional Skill bundles only; adapted context is not written into .agents/skills.
boundaries.context_materializer: Writes only a context envelope and manifest to a dedicated session-local contexts directory and performs integrity verification and managed cleanup.
boundaries.transport: Requires a separately approved architecture contract because the current launcher passes the exact user task once.

runtime: read unchanged route and activation plan
apply overlap, freshness, permission, quality, and cardinality gates
plan required and relevant knowledge units
assemble and hash canonical context envelope

candidate_selection.additional_selection_requires: An explicitly composite task, an approved higher limit, and combined-context evaluation Evidence.

remove: network and credential requirements not approved for the adapted workflow
forbidden: embedding benchmark answers as general knowledge
adding claims not supported by the pinned source
dropping safety constraints to meet a budget

budget_policy.tokenizer_unavailable_behavior: Record null plus reason and enforce the UTF-8 byte hard gate.

data_flow: offline compile into atomic knowledge units
provenance, permission, safety, fixture, and holdout verification
session-local context materialization and integrity check

state_transitions.checkpoint_policy: Atomically record each verified state with the previous checkpoint hash; resume only after the last verified state without implicit re-extraction, retry, or LLM call.
state_transitions.privacy_policy: Persist a minimal task fingerprint and selected IDs, not raw task data, in resumable runtime checkpoints.

safety_boundaries.final_acceptance_source: deterministic output and artifact verification, not context or model self-report

failure_policy.no_match: Continue the independent current path and record NO_CONTEXT.
failure_policy.ambiguity: Use deterministic tie-break only when quality is established; otherwise no context or Human Gate.
failure_policy.budget_overflow: Record BUDGET_BLOCKED; do not truncate or load raw context.
failure_policy.verification_failure: Reject or quarantine the adapted version.
failure_policy.transport_unavailable: Use current path only when independently safe and sufficient; otherwise block.
failure_policy.cleanup_failure: Record QUARANTINED with path and hash evidence.

kpi.name: acceptance_quality
kpi.unit: passed slots and failed hard checks
kpi.direction: higher pass rate and fewer failed checks

kpi.name: prompt_tokens
kpi.unit: actual provider or approved tokenizer tokens
kpi.direction: lower only when quality is non-inferior

kpi.name: loaded_context_bytes
kpi.direction: lower only when quality is non-inferior

kpi.name: llm_calls
kpi.unit: calls separated by execution, extraction, and judge role

kpi.name: execution_time
kpi.direction: lower only when quality is non-inferior

kpi.name: failure_rate
kpi.unit: failures by generation, schema, acceptance, budget, permission, integrity, and cleanup denominator

acceptance_criteria: Wave 1 and Wave 2 facts remain separate and source-linked.
Only approved candidates enter runtime selection.
Raw external snapshots are never injected or used as automatic fallback.
Required correctness, verification, and safety units are never silently truncated.
Every adapted version and runtime envelope has immutable provenance and content hashes.
Permission propagation cannot weaken existing gates.
Router scoring, ACTIVE registry, and the existing Skill Materializer remain unchanged.
Runtime artifacts are session-scoped, integrity-checked, and cleaned or quarantined.
Development and holdout evaluation sets are separated.
Adapted acceptance is non-inferior to current-playbook per candidate before context savings count as success.
Safety, permission, and integrity hard gates pass 100 percent.
Runtime adaptation adds zero LLM calls.
Metric definitions, denominators, thresholds, repetition policy, and missing-data behavior are frozen before a controlled benchmark.
Context transport and architecture integration receive explicit Human Gate approval before implementation.

confounding validator/output-contract changes with context effects
loss of required knowledge or safety during compression
permission laundering and external prompt injection
stale cache or source hash drift
breaking the current exact-user-task launcher invariant
